attr.title: Punktfunk
attr.desc: Experimental native Punktfunk low-latency streaming client for TrimUI Smart Pro S.
attr.desc_md: Experimental **Punktfunk** native low-latency streaming client for **TrimUI Smart Pro S**. Ships the headless CLI plus the SDL3/Vulkan session renderer, with integrated pairing and a single PortMaster launcher.
attr.inst: Run Punktfunk to discover/pair a host and open its library. Remove the obsolete Punktfunk Setup.sh when updating an older installation.
attr.inst_md:
1. Run **Punktfunk**.
2. Select/enter the host and enter its pairing PIN in the built-in console.
3. Open the host library.

When updating an older installation, remove the obsolete `Punktfunk Setup.sh`.

The first release is experimental because the final SDL3/Vulkan WSI path depends on the TSPS Mali firmware stack.
